methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected directly from each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-14. Where a page returned 4xx/5xx or contained no prices (Harness/Split — redirects to contact-sales), this is noted in provenance and monthlyUsd is set to null. LaunchDarkly Foundation is usage-based with no flat floor, so monthlyUsd reflects the minimum ($10 per service connection). DevCycle Business monthlyUsd is the annualized monthly rate ($500/mo when billed annually); month-to-month is $625/mo noted in plan notes. ConfigCat prices are monthly billing rates; annual rates were not available in published page markup. PostHog Feature Flags are usage-based with a free tier; monthlyUsd=0 for plans up to the free threshold, then metered. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null — this is a non-telephony vertical.

vendors.name: LaunchDarkly
vendors.provenance: https://launchdarkly.com/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14; HIPAA listed in Enterprise/Guardian feature comparison table on that page

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: Free tier. Unlimited seats, unlimited feature flags, 10M logs/traces, 5K session replays/errors, 5K AI runs/month. No credit card required.

plans.name: Foundation
plans.notes: Usage-based; $10/service connection/mo + $8.33 per 1K client-side MAU/mo + $5 per 1K AI runs past 5K/mo. Billed yearly. monthlyUsd reflects the per-service-connection floor only. Includes user/account/device targeting, SSO, scalable observability and experimentation.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Advanced targeting, release automation, workflows/scheduling/approvals, SAML/SCIM, custom roles, audit logs, HIPAA.

plans.name: Guardian
plans.notes: Contact sales. Everything in Enterprise plus release monitoring, guardrail metrics, proactive failure notifications, automatic pause/rollback. HIPAA included.

vendors.name: Harness Feature Management (formerly Split)
vendors.provenance: Split.io was acquired by Harness (acquisition completed 2024-06-11) and now redirects to Harness. The Harness pricing page shows Feature Management & Experimentation (FME) as an Enterprise module with no published USD figures (contact sales). However, Harness Developer Hub documents a self-serve 'Start FME Free Plan' that any account can activate without contacting sales (https://developer.harness.io/docs/feature-management-experimentation/getting-started/split-and-harness/), so a confirmable $0 self-serve Free plan is included below. Enterprise USD figures remain quote-only. Fetched 2026-06-14.

plans.name: FME Free Plan
plans.notes: Self-serve free tier. Activated via 'Start FME Free Plan' in the Harness platform, no sales contact required. Core feature flag management and experimentation. Usage limits apply; advanced/enterprise controls require the Enterprise module.

plans.name: Feature Management & Experimentation (Enterprise)
plans.notes: No published USD pricing. Available as an Enterprise module; usage-based on active flags and managed users. Contact Harness sales for a quote.

plans.name: Scale-Up
plans.notes: Month-to-month $300/mo; annual rate $250/mo (~17% saving). 5M+ API requests/month, up to 20 team members, unlimited flags/environments/projects. Adds SAML/SSO, governance, priority support. Overage: $50 per 1M requests.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Custom volume, tailored hosting, real-time support, LDAP + SCIM (upcoming), dedicated onboarding/training, SLA.
